desc: 牛津布防雨、透明大帽檐、书包位与反光条，雨天安心外穿
name: 牛津布书包位儿童雨衣款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清雨衣全貌，干净合规赢点击
一秒传达防雨安心的核心利益，建立第一印象
放大普通衣物淋雨湿透的狼狈，引出雨衣的干爽
雨夜街景背影代入，反光条点亮让家长看见安全感
水珠在面料表面滚落的微距证明防雨能力
透明大帽檐保证视线清晰且可调节，消除遮挡担忧
拉链顺滑防水加内里压胶接缝，证明做工防渗漏
俯视展示量法与尺码结构，消除选码疑虑
同机位四色并列展示，让孩子和颜色双向选择
并排对比有书包位与无书包位两种版型，满足上学场景
用留空的证明位与面料细节降风险，不做虚构资质
橙底收口促单，突出款式丰富与行动引导

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, sky blue #45C5E8 for detail panels, sunny orange #FF8A3D for hero and CTA accents
style.iconSystem: thin-line weather icons in one accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light with front-left key and soft fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars on coated fabric
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cheerful kids rainwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sky blue #45C5E8, sunny orange #FF8A3D and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line weather icons; clean playful product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set, garment always fully spread or naturally worn
style.surfaceSystem: matte light board #EFEAE2 and soft rainy outdoor ambience for scene shots
style.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif, friendly and legible
